responsibility: Implements the root support library’s simple associative-array container used throughout the imported D front end. It provides allocation, lookup with insertion, rvalue lookup, entry counting, and rehashing for a pointer-keyed hash table with small-table inline storage, backing symbol tables and other lightweight maps built on `AA`.
same_name_distinction: Implements the AA container’s storage layout, hashing, bucket growth, lookup/insertion, and rehash behavior; unlike aav.h, which exposes only the opaque AA type and function signatures, this file contains the hash-table mechanics.
